text: Great app! Been using it for less than a week, so yet to see if this is a keeper but so far it has been very useful! The only thing that would make the app perfect would be the addition of widgets. Pro version is a monthly or yearly subscribtion which is too expensive for me. So I don't think I'll ever get that unfortunately (I would pay money for the app if it were a one time payment). Besides that, the free version is great so in any case I would highly recommend this app!
author: L D
developer_reply: Thank you for such a positive review! We're happy you like the app 💚. Please contact us via email at support@respawn.pro (or Contact Support button in the app), we can help you with the subscription issue.
